hitmen.html:
Calgary entered Tuesday at 24-22-8, seventh-ish in the WHL Eastern race after Monday's 1-2-0. It leaves at 26-23-8 (60 pts) with 11 goals for and 7 against. The night went in three acts again: a soft loss in Kelowna, an overtime steal at home against Vancouver, and a statement 7-2 in Everett.

Night totals:

  • gtcoop73: 2G 8A, with a point in all three games and a 6-point night at Everett
  • l Setty l: 3G 6A, including the overtime winner against Vancouver
  • l danks l: 5G 2A, with a hat trick at Everett and two goals in the OT win
  • XFITSKY: 1G 2A
  • Call1-800gambler: 3A
  • Kudolken: 39 saves on 46 across three starts

The takeaway: The top line of gtcoop73–l Setty l–l danks l produced 26 points. That is the support Calgary was missing on Monday. The concern is the first game: out-hit 23-6 in Kelowna and blanked for forty minutes of even strength after XFITSKY's goal. When the Hitmen play on their toes, they look like a playoff team. When they don't, they gift periods. Everett was the answer. Consistency is the question heading into the rest of the week.

games.title: Hitmen Watch: Kelowna Punishes Calgary's Soft Middle
games.html:
The Rockets did not need a power-play goal to beat Calgary. They needed a third period, and they took it. Tied 1-1 after forty minutes, Kelowna scored twice in the third and walked out with a 3-1 win that snapped the Hitmen's chance at an early statement.

Abc6171992 was the night's problem for Calgary: 1G 2A, 7 shots, 9 hits, +2. RunRitzdogg25 and zEDMz each had a goal and an assist. Calgary's only answer came from the blue line — XFITSKY scored the Hitmen goal, with helpers from gtcoop73 and l Setty l. The rest of the Calgary forward group finished at zeros and minus-2.

Possession told a different story than the scoreboard. Calgary held the attacking zone for 11:48 to Kelowna's 6:33 and put 15 shots on Moossiahh, who stopped 14 of them (.933). Kudolken made 16 saves on 19. Kelowna won the faceoff circle 15-9 and out-hit Calgary 23-6. The Hitmen went 0-for-0 on the power play; Kelowna went 0-for-3.

Kelowna went on to finish the night 3-0-0. Calgary opened Tuesday at 24-23-8.

games.title: Hitmen Watch: l danks l Forces Overtime, Then Calgary Steals It
games.html:
This one needed a fifth period, and Calgary was the team that wanted it more when the clock hit zero. Vancouver led 2-1 after two. Calgary tied it in the third. Then l Setty l ended it in overtime.

l danks l scored twice to keep the Hitmen breathing, both goals coming against a Giants team that hit harder (18-9) and spent more time in the attacking zone (14:09 to 13:03). gtcoop73 put up 3 assists without a goal. l Setty l finished with 1G 2A, including the overtime winner, and Calgary converted 1-for-3 on the power play. XFITSKY added an assist and 6 hits from the left point.

xXNateDay31Xx scored both Vancouver goals on 7 shots and threw 6 hits. splashieee- had 2 assists. zackbrown17 stopped 16 of 19. Kudolken answered with 16 saves on 18 (.889) and gave his teammates a chance to steal a point they had nearly left on the table.

Faceoffs were a Calgary clinic: 18-5. The Hitmen moved to 25-23-8 after the overtime win.

games.title: Hitmen Watch: Calgary Empties the Rack in Everett
games.html:
Whatever stalled in Kelowna came roaring back in Everett. The Hitmen scored twice in the first, three in the second and two more in the third, and left the Silvertips looking up at a 7-2 final that closed Tuesday the right way.

gtcoop73 ran the show with 2G 4A. l danks l finished with a hat trick and 2 assists. l Setty l had 2G 3A. All three finished +6. Call1-800gambler added 3 assists from the right point, and XFITSKY chipped in one more. Calgary outshot Everett 16-9, won the faceoff circle 14-13 and held the attacking zone for 12:45 to 10:05. The power play stayed cold at 0-for-3; Everett got one of three.

xTrue0_0Blue and Nelson Yankee88 scored the Silvertips goals. Maytag72 threw 10 hits and added 2 assists in a losing cause. l Stefano l stopped 9 of 16. Kudolken made 7 saves on 9 in his third start of the night.

Calgary ends Tuesday at 26-23-8 (60 pts) after a 2-1-0 night. Everett sits 12-36-4.
